suite: the Groups switches (the map's containers on both models, the grid's assemblies on the fixture)
expect_red: the fixture's grid with the assemblies outermost: no body bracket, the link assembly one bracket under its name, each bearing once per race, and no bracket's name clipped

mutations.contract: With no body round it a top-level assembly is the outermost bracket and is always named, in the body's strip.
mutations.note: An outermost assembly named only where its first row is its own: the link assembly, whose first row is a race's, has no name anywhere in the grid.
